preamble: The voiced alveolar lateral fricative [ɮ] loses its frication and becomes the lateral approximant [l]. In the Bata group of Central Chadic, Proto-Bata *ɮ (from Proto-Central Chadic *ɬ) became l in Bata proper and its close relatives (*ɮa 'cow' > la, *iɮɨ 'bone' > ilɨ).

languageExamples.language: Proto-Bata to Bata Proper (Bata, Bachama, Gude, Jimi, Sharwa and others)

examples.note: Tsuvan keeps ɮ; the shared *ɮ → l defines the Bata Proper subgroup.

sources: Gravina, R. (2014). The Phonology of Proto-Central Chadic: The Reconstruction of the Phonology and Lexicon of Proto-Central Chadic, and the Linguistic History of the Central Chadic Languages. https://www.lotpublications.nl/Documents/375_fulltext.pdf
